title: Inertial Dot Field
hint: Move the pointer · click to send a wave
desc: A precise dot lattice yields around the pointer with damped spring inertia. Click emits a radial impulse; each dot returns to its original position.
seen: An original vanilla implementation inspired by React Bits / Dot Grid.
html: INTERACTION STUDYSPRING
prompt:
Build a self-contained Inertial Dot Field interaction. A precise dot lattice yields around the pointer with damped spring inertia. Click emits a radial impulse; each dot returns to its original position. Use a 320px-high near-black stage, a disciplined grayscale palette with #fa7319 as the only accent, and crisp 1px linework. Move the pointer · click to send a wave. Support Pointer Events, proportional local coordinates, arrow-key navigation and Enter activation. Cap canvas DPR at 2 and delta time at 32ms; resize using ResizeObserver. Stop rendering when offscreen, and cancel animation frames and disconnect observers on unmount. Respect live prefers-reduced-motion changes with a representative static state and direct input updates. Keep HTML, CSS, and JavaScript standalone with no network dependencies.

Use the final composition: regular Inter for interface text and all numerical values with tabular-nums; keep labels in sentence case, normal tracking, and weights 400–500. Remove decorative engineering headers, preserve functional controls and accessible status. Keep the native 320px stage and a restrained palette with subtle borders. Any deliberate Newsreader editorial text in the source remains editorial, not UI.
